No promise, contract, bargain, or agreement, unless it be in writing and be in force unless signed by the party making the same, or by some person thereto in writing and lawfully authorized by him or her, shall be of force or avail in law for any signed. of the following purposes: - (a) for charging any person with the debt, default, or miscarriage of another; (b) for pledging movable property, unless the same shall have been actually delivered to the person to whom it is alleged to have been pledged; (c) for establishing a partnership where the capital exceeds one thousand rupees: Provided that this shall not be construed to prevent third parties from suing partners, or persons acting as such, and offering in evidence circumstances to prove a partnership existing between such persons, or to exclude parol testimony concerning transactions by or the settlement of any account between partners.
